title: Iris Colors in Neonates: Do They Really Change? Prevalence, Predicting Factors and Associated Characteristics
brief_summary: The goal of our study is to examine eye color at birth and the longitudinal change in eye color of preterm and full-term newborns.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Any baby born between the 24-42 week of gestation admitted to the well-baby nursery or the NICU whose parents have signed an informed consent.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Neonatal conjunctivitis
* Neonatal sepsis
* Inborn error of metabolism or genetic syndrome
* Eye abnormalities
* Parental refusal
